cells.description: Data observability platform sold per monitored table; strong dbt Cloud story.

how_we_win: Column-level lineage tied to incidents: show the blast radius demo.
Alert noise: Acme tunes per warehouse, we tune per table.
where_we_lose: Pricing predictability: finance prefers Acme's flat per-table price.
dbt Cloud: Acme integrates natively; we support dbt Core only until Q1 2027.
traps_to_set: Ask: when a column breaks, how do you know which executive dashboards it reaches?

objections.response: Compare monitored tables, not list price: most teams monitor 30-40% of tables. Bring the Soylent time-to-detect proof.

proof_points: Soylent: time-to-detect from 2 days to 40 minutes.
